author: Pedini
text:
Hey ttfreitas, absolutely. First of all, I have been looking for longs
 to join the market from last weeks bullish move. You can see from the
Daily chart that price moved off support forming a nice pin. Then the
bulls came into the market.

I now know the big players have been active and buying, because they
can't hide on the charts. But I am also trying to look for what they
might do next. You can see on the following H4 that price began to
consolidate and created some very clearly defined support. My thought
pattern from this point was is if pro money wanted to push price higher
they would need to get some more orders, and a FO of such clearly
defined support is a perfect way of doing so! Once I saw this I wanted
to look for the most appropriate place the FO move might end: the flip
zone/ignored supply.

Hope this helps!
